name: ribbon-hard
prompt: Revise reference image 1, ONLY the orange cloth ribbon geometry/proportions and shadow opacity. Keep its orange gradient, flat fabric, horizontal top/bottom dashed stitching, empty center, and EXACT existing bubble-dot motif: TEN round white dots at EACH end arranged as two > chevrons of five dots each. Preserve the very good non-button, non-capsule design. The previous ribbon is too thin and the two end cuts are too shallow. Make the colored cloth face taller: full visible composite including shadow must have WIDTH:HEIGHT exactly 5:1 (1400:280), not the previous roughly 8:1. Geometry measured on a 1400x280 final canvas: main face vertices TOP-LEFT (64,2), TOP-RIGHT (1396,2), BOTTOM-RIGHT (1336,256), BOTTOM-LEFT (4,256). Therefore both short edges are steep slanted straight cuts, horizontal offset ONLY 60 px across 254 px vertical height (about 77 degrees to horizontal). Top and bottom long edges perfectly straight horizontal, absolutely no rounded corners or inflated bevel. Beneath the face, same-shape dark #9C2F14 shadow shifted VERTICALLY DOWN only 20 px, not shifted sideways. This shadow layer must be SEMITRANSPARENT at approximately 60 percent opacity, with transparent background visible through it. No opaque thick red bottom extrusion. Main face is opaque, flat cloth top #FFB547 to bottom #FF6A3D; thin top highlight, no glossy button shine. White bubble dots must stay perfectly circular despite taller band. Left motif fainter than right motif; no new dots. Make the 1400:280 composite wide and centered on a generous transparent canvas; it may occupy a wider canvas with transparent top/bottom padding, but the actual silhouette itself must be 5:1. Render large at high resolution, retain clean anti-aliased edges and all corners. No text, bear, stars, lightning or any additional objects. Image 2 is the composition reference only. Only one static horizontal parallelogram ribbon.
